in_hebrew.name: Aleck
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Defender of the people
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Aleck הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek name Alexios, meaning 'helper' or 'defender'. In the New Testament, Saint Alexander of Rome is known as a defender of the Christian faith.

in_greek.name: Aleck
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Defender of the people
in_greek.long_meaning: Aleck είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek name Alexios, meaning 'helper' or 'defender'. In the New Testament, Saint Alexander of Rome is known as a defender of the Christian faith.

in_latin.name: Aleck
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Defender of the people
in_latin.long_meaning: Aleck est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek name Alexios, meaning 'helper' or 'defender'. In the New Testament, Saint Alexander of Rome is known as a defender of the Christian faith.
